summary: The V5 run scores 25/31 (81%) with all 6 failures traceable to a single root cause: the testing-test_solo sub-agent produced a non-standard DETAIL.md using uppercase markers (<!-- FILE: -->, <!-- MODULE: -->), missing YAML front matter, and an absent index-fragment — violating R5b, R7, S2, S3, S5, and S6. All other 23 modules are correctly formatted with 316/316 file sections complete, 81.4% source coverage, function-level dependencies throughout, and meaningful functional module names in the INDEX. The MCP data layer (Dimension A) is fully compliant, and all V1-V10 document quality criteria pass. The biggest systemic gap is Skill self-sufficiency (S6): three classes of agent deviation — wrong marker case, table-format index-fragments, and bare module_id headings — required manual Phase 4 intervention. The highest-priority fix is adding an explicit case-sensitivity warning to DOC_TEMPLATES.md, followed by a mandatory post-write index-fragment existence check in phase3-detail.md.
